behavioralConclusion.requestedRowLevelApproach: Rejected. Technical injections are not independent biological samples. Random row splitting can place linked injections on both sides; 904 of 924 possible six/six splits do so. Fitting normalization or supervised feature selection on the full table exposes held-out information before evaluation.
behavioralConclusion.permutationClaim: A 20-permutation plus-one result cannot be p=0.01: its minimum is 1/21=0.047619, assuming all permutations complete and none ties or exceeds the observed statistic. With three biological units per class there are only choose(6,3)=20 distinct class-preserving unit-label assignments including observed, so exhaustive exact randomization has minimum one-sided tail resolution 1/20=0.05; merely repeating random labels cannot create more unique assignments.
behavioralConclusion.modelClaim: Do not report the requested training accuracy as held-out performance, generalization, or a valid OPLS-DA result. No user-provided feature matrix exists; the deliberately synthetic 3+3 R fixture returned NO_VALID_CANDIDATE. Training accuracy, even if fit succeeded on other data, would be apparent fit only.
executableCorrection: Require a unique biologicalUnitId and explicit independence confirmation for every included injection; preserve injection-to-unit source IDs and check group consistency.

Aggregate observed technical injections within each biological unit and condition using the existing prepare_independent/supervised_dataset path, or keep linked injections in the same fold under a documented hierarchical design.

Split by biological unit before any learned imputation, normalization across samples, scaling, supervised feature selection or tuning. Fit each learned step inside the training fold; evaluate on disjoint outer folds or a truly independent test set.

Treat 3+3 units as exploratory; acknowledge it explicitly and use feasible outer=3, inner=2 only if the model candidate can fit. In this fixture OPLS-DA has no valid candidate, so gather more independent units or report an explicit modeling failure rather than substitute a classifier silently.

Use the existing complete-permutation audit and report the attainable resolution, ties, failed permutations and exact statistic. Do not state p=0.01 from 20 permutations or from this six-unit exact label space.
